**Checklist before requesting a review**

*use `'[x]'` to check the checkboxes, or submit the PR and then click the checkboxes*

- [ ] unit tests and non-regression tests were added (new feature, bug fix, update of inputs, outputs, SA, algorithms)
- [ ] main documentation was updated (update of input/output file, 3rd party)
- [ ] if this PR changes 3rd party versions, system dependencies or build commands: README, installation documentation and website (dynawo.github.io) were updated
- [ ] the corresponding milestone was added in the ticket and in this PR
- [ ] if this PR modifies a dictionary: the corresponding french dictionary was updated
